Una torre entre la botánica y el cielo: A tower between botany and the sky
La historia del Observatorio comienza en: The Observatory's story begins in a world where measuring the sky was also a way of understanding the land.
Su origen se vincula a José Celestino Mu: Its origins are linked to José Celestino Mutis and the Royal Botanical Expedition. Historical studies document astronomical and meteorological activity before the building existed: Mutis's records, Francisco José de Caldas's work and their exchanges with Alexander von Humboldt help reconstruct that context.
El trabajo de Alberto Gómez Gutiérrez in: Alberto Gómez Gutiérrez's work examines this background through documents, diaries and correspondence. The tower emerged from a network of scientific practices connecting observation, travel, geography and collections.
Alberto Gómez Gutiérrez: antecedentes de: Alberto Gómez Gutiérrez: the OAN's background ↗
Construida por fray Domingo de Petrés, l: Built by Friar Domingo de Petrés, the historic observatory has a distinctive octagonal plan. The Señal Memoria archive preserves Benjamín Calvo's explanation of its architecture and images of the building in central Bogotá.
Señal Memoria: historia y archivo audiov: Señal Memoria: history and audiovisual archive ↗
La obra impulsada por Mutis comienza en: Construction, promoted by Mutis, begins in May 1802 and ends on August 20, 1803, within the setting of the Botanical Expedition.
Un estudio de documentos publicado en 20: A documentary study published in 2025 analyzes solar observations, magnetic declination measurements and observations of Jupiter's satellites from April to September 1804.
Caldas se establece en Santafé a finales: Caldas settles in Santafé in late 1805 and carries out sustained astronomical and meteorological work from 1806.
El edificio atraviesa interrupciones y c: The building experiences interruptions and changes of use. The careers of Liévano, González Benito and Garavito reflect different efforts to strengthen astronomical practice.
Las fuentes distinguen la incorporación: Sources distinguish incorporation into Universidad Nacional in 1867 from its ratification in 1936; this distinction matters in the institution's history.

El número inaugural acompaña la conmemor: The inaugural issue accompanies the 220th anniversary and opens a publishing space for the community.

Instrumentos: otras formas de leer el pa: Instruments: other ways to read the past
Un instrumento conserva algo más que una: An instrument preserves more than an observing technique. It invites questions about what was measured, how people learned to use it, who built it and what results it produced. Studying the relationship between objects and documents is essential to understanding astronomical heritage.
El análisis de las observaciones de 1804: The analysis of the 1804 observations identifies solar records presumably intended to determine how fast or slow a chronometer and pendulum clock were running. Timekeeping was thus closely connected to observing the sky.
El mismo estudio analiza observaciones d: The same study analyzes observations of Jupiter's satellites intended to refine geographical longitude, as well as magnetic declination measurements. Documents help reconstruct practices even when the identity of the observers remains debated.
Para investigar telescopios, relojes, br: Research into telescopes, clocks, compasses, sextants and other historical instruments should compare inventories, inscriptions, photographs and records of use. These examples guide research; they are not an inventory of objects currently on display.
Esta web no sustituye un catálogo museol: This website does not replace a museum catalogue. An object's identification, maker, date, provenance and condition must be supported by its documentary record.
Un patrimonio que también está vivo: A heritage that is also alive

El diseño vincula especies asociadas a l: The design connects species associated with botanical tradition with the memory of Mutis, Humboldt and Garavito. It links astronomy, cultural landscape and environmental education.
